subject: Deployment playlist + milestone owners — Aurora Health onboarding
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Park <danielle@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & timeline for Aurora Health onboarding

Danielle —

Thanks again for a productive kickoff yesterday. Attached is a first-pass deployment playlist (labelled Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx) that breaks the onboarding into 6-week sprints with milestone owners and acceptance gates. Key points in this draft:

- Sprint 0 (Provisioning): networking, VPC peering, and KMS integration — owner: Aurora infra (IT) + Redwood infra (Marcus)
- Sprint 1 (Model & API validation): model choice, perf targets, basic routing — owner: Redwood ML (Monica)
- Sprint 2 (Security & Compliance): SOC evidence handover, log retention, audit hooks — owner: Aurora compliance + Ben (redwood)
- Sprint 3 (Pilot): user flows, quality checks, latency SLO verification — owner: Aurora product + Naomi
- Cutover & Ramp: go/no-go gates and rollback playbooks

Action items I want to confirm this week:
1) Confirm owner names for the Aurora tasks (I've put placeholders in the sheet).
2) Target windows — do the week-of Jun 21 for Sprint 0 provisioning and Jul 6 for Sprint 1 validation look feasible on your side?
3) Any procurement milestones we should surface now (e.g., MFA tokens, cert approvals)?

I'm copying Marcus, Monica, and Ben so we can finalize owner commitments and produce a one-page mutual action plan for your procurement and legal teams. If you prefer a quick 30-minute sync to lock owners, I'm available Thu 10–11am PT.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0198

Attachments: Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Danielle Park <danielle@aurorahealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurora Health IT <it@aurorahealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & timeline for Aurora Health onboarding

Naomi —

Appreciate the detailed breakdown. A few quick things from my side after a first pass:

- Sprint 0 window: the week of Jun 21 is tight for our networking team because of a scheduled data center maintenance. Can we shift provisioning to Jun 28 — Jul 2?
- For Sprint 1, Jul 6 is OK but we need the model validation checklist up front (metrics you will measure). Can Monica share a short template?
- Procurement: we do need an MFA device list and cert-owner name for Jun 15. I'll put the request with procurement today.

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood produce a one-page summary showing milestone, owner, and acceptance criteria? That will help my director sign the MAP.
2) Please include any SLA caveats (e.g., fallback model variant when dedicated capacity is saturated) — our security team wants to understand failure modes.

Happy to take the 30-minute sync — Thu 10–10:30am PT works for me.

Best,
Danielle Park
Head of Product Ops | Aurora Health
danielle@aurorahealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Park <danielle@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & timeline for Aurora Health onboarding

Thanks — I updated the sheet with more granular owners and added a short acceptance-criteria column. Highlights of my updates:

- Provisioning (Sprint 0): Redwood infra will provision the test cluster and validate VPC peering by Jul 2; Aurora IT to confirm firewall rules by Jun 30.
- KMS integration: target Jul 6 for key exchange and test decryption (Ben will run a verification).
- SLA fallback: added a section describing model variant fallback (low-cost small model) + automatic routing to hosted region in case dedicated pool is saturated; see "SLA-notes" tab.

I attached a quick PNG that diagrams the recommended deployment sequence (deployment-sequence-diagram.png). Monica — can you draft the validation checklist that Danielle asked for and drop it into the sheet by EOD Fri?

Naomi — I'll join the Thu sync.

—Marcus
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

Attachments: deployment-sequence-diagram.png (image)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Park <danielle@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment playlist + milestone owners — Aurora Health onboarding

Danielle / team —

Thanks for the quick responses and for shifting the windows. Per our sync just now, attached is the one-page MAP (final draft) and the redlines to the standard SLA we discussed (SLA-redlines-aurora.pdf). Summary of decisions from the call:

- Sprint 0 (Provisioning): Jun 28 — Jul 2. Owners: Aurora IT (T. Nguyen) + Redwood Infra (Marcus). Acceptance gate: VPC + firewall verified in staging by Jul 2.
- Sprint 1 (Model validation): Jul 6 — Jul 17. Owners: Monica Patel (Redwood ML) + Aurora analytics (E. Rivera). Acceptance gate: generation quality >= agreed baseline and 95th pct latency < 450ms for sample prompts. Monica added the validation checklist to the Drive link included.
- Security & Compliance: Ben to upload SOC evidence pointer documents and a proposed log retention config by Jul 9.
- Pilot & Cutover: pilot for a single product flow scheduled Jul 20 — Jul 31; full ramp contingent on pilot OK.

Next steps (please reply with confirmations or redlines):
- Danielle: confirm the procurement milestone (MFA device list) by Jun 15.
- Aurora IT: confirm firewall rule owner and provide a test IP by Jun 22.
- Redwood: Marcus and Ben to deliver staging provisioning and KMS test by Jul 6.

If everything looks good I'll convert the sheet into a signed MAP PDF and share a DocuSign link for Aurora director approval.

Thanks everyone —
Naomi
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

Attachments: Aurora_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated with owners), SLA-redlines-aurora.pdf (pdf)
